name: Lone Line (Cô Tuyến)

bonuses.effect: The Line Is Patient (Tuyến Năng Nhẫn)
bonuses.rule: while you hold the sitting stance, your linh lực leech also heals you for half as much, and every 5 s you hold it your next hook art is a sure hit.

story: The bone hook that was the school's first made thing and the robe he wore while he pieced the method back together.

name: Heap of Snow (Tuyết Đôi)

bonuses.rule: while you sit, your ward gains 2 % of its value each second; when a foe breaks it, your next counter art fires twice.

story: The straw cape, the old men's gourd and a stone from under the ice: the river's own set, made by no smith. Bồ means them to go to the first disciple who reaches the ninth layer.
